description: Search the VoiceAssistants directory of local US businesses by what the person needs (a trade such as "plumber", a service such as "drain cleaning", or a business name) and where (city and two-letter state). Optional filters: open right now, available today, or a maximum starting price in US dollars. Returns up to `limit` businesses, each with an `id` to pass to get_business, get_hours or answer_question. If nothing matches exactly, the search is widened and `relaxed` says how. Results are ordered by how recently each business was verified, never by payment. Read `spoken` aloud as the answer.

available_today.description: Only businesses that have confirmed today that they can take new work today.

max_starting_price.description: Only businesses with a published starting price at or below this many US dollars.

open_now.description: Only businesses open at this moment in their own time zone.

query.description: What is needed: a trade ("plumber"), a service ("AC repair") or a business name. Plain words.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example "FL".

name: find_businesses
title: Find local businesses
